description: This Python source file defines a class for configuring and transforming search requests and responses for the Linkup search API within a larger search framework. It includes methods for environment validation, URL construction, request transformation, and response parsing, specifically tailored for the Linkup API.

classes.name: LinkupSearchConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for interacting with the Linkup search API, including environment validation, URL generation, request transformation, and response parsing.

methods.name: ui_friendly_name
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for the search provider, 'Linkup'.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates API environment variables and constructs authorization headers.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for the search endpoint, appending '/search' if necessary.

methods.name: transform_search_request
methods.description: Transforms a generic search query and parameters into the Linkup API request format.

methods.name: transform_search_response
methods.description: Parses the raw HTTP response from Linkup API and converts it into a standardized SearchResponse format.
